Harmony

Find three cards where every emblem that shows up appears exactly twice. Six emblems are shared in pairs and two are missing from all three. Play alone, or race opponents to each one.

Deck 0

Mirror

A memory game. Turn over two cards; they match when they are opposites, so together they show all eight emblems once. With opponents, take turns; finding a pair earns another turn.

Turns 0 Pairs 0

Echo

Cards flip onto the pile. Slap when the top two share exactly three emblems for 1 point; slap an opposite pair for 3. A wrong slap costs you 1. Press Space or the Slap button.

Seek

You and your opponent each hold a secret card. On your turn, pick any card and ask how many emblems it shares with their secret. Name the exact card (an answer of 4) before they name yours.

Clans

Rummy with emblems. Draw from the deck or take the top discard, lay down melds, then discard one card. A clan is three or more cards that share the same three emblems. An opposite pair is a two-card meld. You may add a card to any clan on the table. Empty your hand to win.

Great Loop

Lay all 70 cards in one chain where each card shares exactly three emblems with the one before it, then close the loop back to the first card. Only playable cards are bright.

The deck

Every way to choose 4 of the 8 emblems, once each. Each emblem has three traits, and the 14 cards with a gold frame are Omens: four emblems that make a flat plane of the cube, such as all warm things or all high things.
